{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')
print(f"Shape before deduplication: {df.shape}")
print(f"Number of unique patients: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_ids: {df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")
print(f"Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check sample_seq: is highest sample_seq the latest? (should be)
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient:\n{df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts()}")

# Check distribution of arms by severity
print(f"Distribution of arms by severity:\n{pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity'])}")

# Check if assay_batch affects response
print(f"Response rate by assay_batch:\n{df.groupby('assay_batch')['responded'].mean()}")"}
